plain_english: Within You-alone-one, of throbbing glory, of the knowledge-ocean, the taste of varied wave-masses spreading by own taste — they indeed, these creation-keeping-dissolving-formed ones, of moon-sun-fires' clash-gleams, at once are rise-and-set powers.
sanskrit_cite: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso | sṛṣṭisthitilayamaya sphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ
